title: Question 7
passage:
Where can I fill my water bottle before we leave?
A. The bottle holds a full liter. B. At the fountain beside the stairs. C. I brought the empty one.
passageZh:
出發前，我可以在哪裡裝飲用水？
A. 這個瓶子可以裝一公升。
B. 在樓梯旁的飲水台。
C. 我帶的是空的那個。
